data.title: Riyadh Ranks First among 194 Cities Worldwide in 2026 UN Local Online Service Index
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Riyadh ranked first worldwide in the United Nations Local Online Service Index (LOSI), up from third in the 2024 assessment. The city scored 100% in every category of the index, which was part of the 2026 UN E-Government Survey covering cities in 194 countries.
    The Riyadh Region Municipality contributed to the city’s rise in the rankings by developing its digital services across all six areas the index measures. These are service provision, content provision, the institutional framework, e-government literacy, e-government infrastructure, and participation and engagement.
    The achievement aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals to make government more effective, accelerate digital transformation, and deliver services more efficiently to users. These efforts strengthen Riyadh’s competitiveness among cities worldwide.
    Riyadh’s first-place ranking reflects the work of the Riyadh Municipal Transformation Program, which aims to achieve comprehensive digital transformation. The program seeks to bring high-quality services closer to residents and improve their quality of life in tangible ways in their daily lives. It also aims to develop advanced smart services that help keep Riyadh among the world’s leading cities.
    -- SPA
